# SlideMaker.app

> SlideMaker.app is a free AI-powered presentation maker that transforms text, documents, and ideas into professional slides in minutes using natural language processing.

SlideMaker.app provides an accessible, no-payment-required platform for creating presentations across education, marketing, corporate training, and healthcare sectors. The tool supports multiple input formats (PDF, DOCX) and export options, with 30+ customizable themes and data visualization capabilities.
